ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black region at the central peduncle junction extending toward the median notch. Heavy black mottling and irregular speckling concentrated along the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes. Central regions of both lobes feature high-intensity white fields with sparse, isolated dark pixel clusters.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth of notch is roughly 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge with high-frequency serrations; notable jagged peaks and valleys across the entire length, with larger-amplitude indentations on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-to-convex sigmoid curve; the inner margin near the notch is concave, transitioning to a broad convex sweep towards the outer lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark circular pixel clusters detected predominantly on the medial portion of the right lobe and near the lower-left leading edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear disruptions visible on the left lobe near the median notch, and horizontal-oriented dark streaks on the upper-right white field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Both lateral fluke tips exhibit dark, high-texture, irregular masses suggesting significant physical trauma or dense barnacle colonization/scarring.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple pinnipeds (seals) in the immediate foreground, with the nearest seal partially occluding the lower central fluke area and creating splash patterns that mask pixel data at the fluke-water interface.
